title: RBI issues draft ‘Guidance on Regulatory Expectations for Data Governance’
description: Reserve Bank of India has today released the draft ‘Guidance on Regulatory Expectations for Data Governance’ for public comments. The draft Guidance is applicable to following regulated entities: Commercial Banks Small Finance Banks Payments Banks Local Area Banks Regional Rural Banks Urban Co-operative Banks Rural Co-operative Banks All India Financial Institutions Non-Banking Financial Companies Asset Reconstruction Companies Credit Information Companies 2.
